alignments.note: One Greek participle rendered by the four-word idiom *laying up in store*; head on the verb word *laying*, the remaining words being the English idiom's own parts. Heading on *store*, which echoes the θησαυρ- element, remains defensible.
Reflexive dative; the case preposition *for* stays with the pronoun under rule 21's determinerless clause.
Attributive adjective, split under rule 26 despite the ASV's reordering.
Anarthrous noun; the supplied *a* is its rule 7 helper under rule 51's anarthrous clause, discontinuously around the adjective under rule 15.
Rule 60's closing clause with rule 102: the article supplies the nominal *time* along with its determiner, headed on the nominal.
Substantival participle rendered *to come*, the infinitival marker its rule 7 helper.
Purpose conjunction realized by the complementizer *that* under rule 40.
Subjunctive rendered by the support-verb phrase *lay hold* with its supplied subject and modal under rule 9; rule 17 heads on the meaning-bearing complement.

Article preceding its noun whose adverbial modifier the ASV recasts as a finite relative clause; rule 31 gives it the discontinuous *the … which* along with the case preposition *on* under rules 17 and 21, headed on *the*. Rule 92 confirms that a bare adverb is not a token able to carry the relativizer.
Head noun, left bare by rule 31 because its article precedes it.
Adverbial predicate carrying the supplied copula under rule 53, discontinuously around the `added` repetition under rule 15, headed on the adverb.

Rule 103: the ASV repeats the predicate nominal *life* that ζωῆς has already been spent on at t022, and supplied lexical content whose source token is realized elsewhere in the verse is `added`. Reading it as a discontinuous second realization of ζωῆς under rule 15 remains defensible.

review_notes: τῆς takes *the … which* under rule 31, the modifier being a bare adverb with no verb to carry the relativizer; the copula still splits off onto ὄντως under rule 53.
The second *life** is `added` under rule 103 rather than folded onto ζωῆς.
